in_urdu.name: ایتمان
in_urdu.meaning: وفاء کا اتمام، کام کا مکمل ہونا، نقصتوں سے پاک ہونا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایتمان کا لفظ عربي زبان کے الفاظ کا ترجمہ ہے جو وفاء بالوعد، کام کا مکمل ہونا، نقصتوں سے پاک ہونا، اور دین کی طرف سے استقامت کرنا کہتا ہے۔ یہ لفظ اپنی اہمیت کے باعث مسلم والدین کے لیے ایک خوبصورت نام ہے جو ان کی اولاد کو بھلائی اور سچائی کی طرف متوجہ کرتا ہے، اور ان کی نسل کو پاک و صاف رکھنے کی ترغیب دیتا ہے

in_hindi.name: इत्मान
in_hindi.meaning: वफ़ा का पूरा होना, काम का पूरा होना, दोषों से मुक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: इत्मान एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ है वफ़ा का पूरा होना, काम का पूरा होना, दोषों से मुक्ति और अपने धर्म की ओर से स्थिर रहना। यह शब्द अपनी महत्वपूर्णता के कारण मुस्लिम माता-पिता के लिए एक सुंदर नाम है जो उनकी संतान को अच्छाई और सच्चाई की ओर आकर्षित करता है, और उनकी नस्ल को साफ और स्वच्छ बनाने के लिए प्रेरित करता है।

in_english.name: Itmaan
in_english.meaning: fulfillment of promises, completion of tasks, purification from flaws, steadfastness in faith
in_english.long_meaning: Itmaan is a term derived from the Arabic root ع ت م (ʿ-t-m), which signifies the fulfillment of promises, completion of tasks, purification from flaws, and steadfastness in faith. The term appears in the Quran in Surah Al-Baqarah, Verse 181, and conveys the idea of achieving something, fulfilling a commitment, and avoiding flaws. Itmaan is a significant concept in Islamic tradition, emphasizing the importance of integrity, sincerity, and devotion in one's actions and endeavors.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Itmaan" holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community as it is rooted in the principle of relying on Allah (God) for support, guidance, and strength amidst life's challenges. In a world where trust and authenticity are vital, being known as "Itmaan" denotes trustworthiness, dependability, and integrity, enhancing one's reputation and relationships within various circles.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, adopting the name "Itmaan" carries the profound meaning of placing unwavering faith and trust in Allah. It is a reminder to continue seeking His divine guidance throughout daily life, and to rely on His wisdom and protection. This name also highlights the importance of being trustworthy to others, and cultivating sincerity and reliability in all personal and spiritual relationships, ultimately fostering a deeper and stronger bond with Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Faith, Trust" symbolizes Reliance on Allah, Trustworthiness. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Itmaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of faith, trust.
